parsed.why: Never criminalised; documented tolerance and culturally legible trans presentation, no targeting or violence recorded. But censorship, no recourse and 'immodesty' enforcement leave a quiet, thin, unprotected climate.

Penal code omits a same-sex offence, yet police and military raid, collectively detain and sexually abuse LGBT people, especially trans women; impunity, conversion rape, unresolved vagrancy law. State-tolerated targeting dominates.

No criminalisation and a 2018 equality guarantee, but thin record, no complaint machinery, gender identity unprotected, church-dominated conservative locales; recourse informal. Silence not read as danger, but nothing protects.

No criminalisation and courts have acted for trans people, yet documented public and institutional discrimination plus physical/sexual harassment in provincial cities, and rising political hostility with death threats.
No criminalisation, but a decency statute with doubled same-sex penalty, documented assault surge and killings, victim-blaming police and impunity, plus presidential rhetoric against homosexuality.
